newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki seen flat to firmer, awaiting U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki seen flat to firmer, awaiting U.S. data.

text.p: Shares were seen opening flat to firmer on Friday after Wall Street rose overnight, but with caution prevailing ahead of U.S. jobs figures due at 1530/1230 GMT, brokers said.
"This will continue to be a rather bland week on the stock market," one broker said. Operators await U.S. May payrolls and employment rate figures and this was likely to dampen trade.
Brokers said they would be watching Tamro after the drugs wholesaler reported four-month profits above the median of analysts' forecasts.
"Tamro came out with a good result," one broker said.
Scope was also seen for continued strength in Outokumpu after it rose yesterday on four-month profits above the highest of analysts' predictions, brokers said.
Nokia gained in New York overnight, but ended just 1.00 markka above its Helsinki close and was not seen likely to spark a rally.
